name: a coordinate reference resolves to the cell it names
geml:
=== table {#fy format=csv header=1 summary="Segment = 'Total'; Q1 = sum(Q1)"}
Segment, Q1
Cloud, 8
Edge, 3
===

Q1 is [[#fy[1]["Q1"]]].

name: a coordinate reference may name a whole row
geml:
=== table {#fy format=csv header=1 summary="Segment = 'Total'; Q1 = sum(Q1)"}
Segment, Q1
Cloud, 8
Edge, 3
===

Row: [[#fy[2]]].

name: a coordinate reference may name the summary row
geml:
=== table {#fy format=csv header=1 summary="Segment = 'Total'; Q1 = sum(Q1)"}
Segment, Q1
Cloud, 8
Edge, 3
===

Total: [[#fy[summary]["Q1"]]].

name: a coordinate reference may name a column
geml:
=== table {#fy format=csv header=1 summary="Segment = 'Total'; Q1 = sum(Q1)"}
Segment, Q1
Cloud, 8
Edge, 3
===

All: [[#fy["Q1"]]].

name: an inline projection of a coordinate is its value
geml:
=== table {#fy format=csv header=1 summary="Segment = 'Total'; Q1 = sum(Q1)"}
Segment, Q1
Cloud, 8
Edge, 3
===

Projected: ![[#fy[1]["Q1"]]].

===

=== meta
title = "Second"
